newsitem.title: UK: UK bookmakers cut odds on Conservative win to 7-4.
newsitem.headline: UK bookmakers cut odds on Conservative win to 7-4.

text.p: Bookmakers on Friday cut the odds on the ruling Conservatives winning the next election to 7-4 from 2-1 following their party conference.
This followed heavy betting support for the ruling party this week. Labour's odds were pushed out to 2-5 from 1-3. The Liberal Democrats were quoted at 300-1.
"The feelgood factor seems to be back amongst Conservative punters," a William Hill spokesman said in a statement.
